top_issues: Number formatting is inconsistent: total '$162.99' and 'Reserve $40.00' carry $, but USDC row shows bare '135.00' and WETH shows '0.01 ≈ $27.99' — the eye cannot tell which unit each figure is in.
The green/violet bar segments and the 'On-chain / Reserve / Secured / Hub promise' legend are unexplained on first sight; 'Secured $0.00' is jargon that means nothing to a first-timer.
Right rail 'ACCOUNTS' card mixes position (+95.00 owes you), capacity (send up to 155.00) and a bar with no scale note, so the same bar grammar as the header is not yet teachable here.
fixes: Force one money format rule: every USD amount gets '$' and 2 decimals; token amounts get the ticker suffix; never mix bare and prefixed numbers in the same column.
Add a one-line microcopy under the breakdown bars: 'Green = yours on-chain or in reserve; violet = a hub's promise' and rename 'Secured' to 'Collateral held for you'.
Put the active '1 px = $X' scale chip in the header so every bar on the page is anchored to a visible rule.

top_issues: The 'To' field renders the full 40-char address 0x92c2d7...2cbf0 in monospace, dominating the field and reading as noise rather than a verified recipient.
'Up to 155.00 instantly' sits as a small right-aligned caption above the amount; its relationship to the 'send up to 155.00' bar below is duplicated and unclear.
Route card and the before/after 'YOUR ACCOUNT WITH H1' card both use bars but the after-bar's violet growth is not labeled as 'hub promise increased'.
fixes: Show recipient as 'H2 · 0x92c2…cbf0' with a copy affordance; keep the long hex behind a tap.
Merge the capacity hint into the bar's own label ('send up to 155.00') and drop the duplicate caption.
Annotate the after-state bar segment that changed: '+25.00 hub promise' so the delta is read, not inferred.

top_issues: 'Settled 05:36:11  in 8s' juxtaposes an absolute clock time with a relative duration with no separator or label, reading as a glitch.
Proof hash is truncated to 0xc64e83c2…3207 with no way to expand or copy it from the modal, undercutting the 'provable' promise at the moment of proof.
The dimmed home behind the modal still shows a stale balance ($137.99 vs the pre-pay $162.99) creating a momentary contradiction.
fixes: Render as 'Settled 05:36:11 · confirmed in 8s' with the duration as a muted badge.
Make the Proof row tap-to-copy with a 'View full hash' inline expander.
Update the background balance to the post-payment value before showing the modal, or fully blur it.

top_issues: '45.50 capacity via H1' is unexplained jargon placed right of the amount field; a payer scanning the QR does not need the receiver's inbound capacity.
'YOUR ENTITY ID' long hex wraps to two lines in a narrow card and is visually heavier than the QR that is the actual deliverable.
Three copy actions ('Copy invoice', 'Copy link', 'Copy xln:// app link') have no hierarchy; the user cannot tell which to send to a client.
fixes: Move capacity into a small info popover on 'Prepare incoming account'; keep the amount card clean.
Collapse entity id to '0x75b2…77ef · copy' on one line.
Promote 'Copy invoice' as the primary action and demote link/app-link to a secondary row labeled 'other ways to share'.

top_issues: Limit price reads '2,500.5000 USD per WETH' — the comma-as-thousands plus 4-decimal tail makes the price ambiguous (2500.5? 2,500,500?).
A red 'Prepare incoming capacity before swapping' warning sits above a disabled CTA, blocking the core task with no one-click resolution on this screen.
The 'Prepare to receive / collateral slider / Accept as credit' block is a second full workflow bolted under the swap; the page tries to be swap + account-opening at once.
fixes: Use a locale-safe price: '2 500.50 USDC / WETH' with a thin space for thousands and trailing zeros trimmed to the tick size.
Make the red warning a button: 'Open capacity with H1' that jumps to Move pre-filled, instead of a dead stop.
Collapse the collateral/credit prep into an expandable 'Advance: set collateral terms' disclosure so a plain swap is one decision.

top_issues: '+70.00 they owe you' and 'Your credit line to them 115.50' and 'Collateral 60.00' are three numbers whose arithmetic relationship is never stated; the user can't tell if 70 is within 60 collateral or uncovered.
The legend row (collateral/at risk/you owe/credit room/in flight) uses five colors but the per-asset bars below only show green+violet+grey, so two legend entries never appear and feel decorative.
WETH lane shows a near-empty bar with a tiny violet sliver and 'receive up to 0.00' — an empty lane rendered as if meaningful.
fixes: Add a derived line: 'Uncovered by collateral: 10.00' (position 70 − collateral 60) so risk is computed, not guessed.
Show only legend colors that occur on the page, or render the missing segments (at-risk, in-flight) on the bars.
Suppress zero-capacity lanes into the 'Show 1 empty lane' row rather than a full card.

top_issues: Timestamps are bare clock times (05:36:03) with no date; under 'TODAY' that is fine, but the same format would be unreadable for older rows and for exported CSV reconciliation.
'Swap filled' row shows a status but no amount, while 'Swap placed' shows 20.00 USDC — the filled value is the more important number and is missing.
The right detail panel duplicates the selected row with no visual link line back to the list, so on a wide screen the connection is implicit.
fixes: Use 'Today 05:36' for recent and '12 Mar 05:36' beyond today; keep full ISO in CSV.
Show the filled amount on the 'Swap filled' row (e.g. '0.008 WETH').
Draw a thin connector or highlight gutter between the selected list row and the detail card.

top_issues: This frame is visually identical to 07 with the same row selected, so the 'detail' state adds no new information — the detail panel is always-on rather than a drill-in, wasting the dedicated screen.
The detail panel's 'Frames 2 committed entries' is the strongest proof element yet it is the last row and unstyled.
No per-row action (copy proof, open in block explorer, dispute) exists in the detail view.
fixes: Differentiate the detail state: collapse the list to a narrow rail and expand the record with its bar timeline and signatures.
Promote '2 committed frames' to a tappable proof chip with the frame numbers (#135→#136).
Add a footer action row in the detail: Copy proof · View frames · Dispute.

top_issues: 'Reveal recovery phrase' is a plain button in the Vault row with no confirm step or warning color, one mis-tap from exposing the seed.
The bar-scale slider, its 'Auto/$1/$2…' chips and the right 'AT THIS SCALE' preview are three controls for one concept with no shared label grouping.
'Mode embedded', 'Runtime id', 'Frame #152' are developer facts shown to end users in the same weight as user preferences.
fixes: Gate 'Reveal recovery phrase' behind a hold-to-reveal or password confirm and tint it danger-red.
Wrap slider + chips + preview in one titled card 'Bar scale (1 px = $X)'.
Move runtime id/frame/mode into a collapsible 'Advanced / diagnostics' section.

top_issues: FROM and TO both render three cards with balances; the selected pair (Reserve→Account) is shown by a violet border only, which is subtle against the dark surface.
'Add to batch' has no explanation of what a batch is or where it goes, so the secondary CTA is uninterpretable.
The 'WHAT HAPPENS' panel describes the reserve→account effect but never shows the resulting bar change, breaking the bar grammar used everywhere else.
fixes: Add a checkmark + filled background to the selected FROM/TO card, not just a border.
Rename 'Add to batch' to 'Queue as batched move' with a one-line tooltip.
Render a before/after bar in WHAT HAPPENS like the Pay screen does.

top_issues: The hub of five nav cards (Sovereignty, Move, Assets, Lending, Ownership) is the primary content but reads as a flat menu with no state or counts.
'Yours whatever a hub does $40.00' and 'Promised by hubs $97.99' use conversational phrasing that is charming but imprecise for a treasurer reconciling.
'NEEDS ATTENTION — Nothing waiting on you' is an empty card taking prime space.
fixes: Add a live badge to each card (e.g. Assets '3 tokens', Lending '0 active', Ownership '1 of 1 board').
Add parenthetical definitions: 'Yours (on-chain + reserve) $40.00', 'Promised by hubs (unsecured) $97.99'.
Collapse the empty Needs-Attention card into a single muted line.

top_issues: All three token balances are 0.00, yet the page leads with them; the real utility (faucets) is buried in the right column.
The right rail stacks five near-identical destination buttons (Receive from H1 disabled, to on-chain wallet, gas to wallet, straight to reserve) with no grouping — a faucet with too many exits.
'Depository may pull 0.00' under each token is cryptic and alarming without context.
fixes: When on-chain is empty, surface the faucet as the primary card and demote the zero balances.
Group faucet destinations under one 'Send test funds to:' segmented control.
Replace 'Depository may pull' with a tooltip-bearing 'Reserve claimable' label.

top_issues: H1 POOL shows Available/Borrowed/Active principal all 0.00, so the entire lending feature looks non-functional with no empty-state guidance.
'Interest you ask · basis points 100 = 1.00% per term' forces the user to convert bps to % mentally; the term basis ('per term' vs annualized) is ambiguous.
The Borrow tab exists but the form only ever shows 'Amount to lend', so the toggle's effect is invisible.
fixes: Add an empty-state note: 'No liquidity in this pool yet — be the first lender' with a suggested rate.
Show both: '100 bps = 1.00% per term ≈ X% APR' and label the term explicitly.
Swap the amount field label and pool stats when Borrow is selected.

top_issues: The page describes the board but offers no action to 'issue shares or change owners' that the copy itself references, leaving the task incomplete.
'Kind: Lazy (hash of its board)' is internal terminology exposed without a definition.
The 'TAKE CONTROL OF ANOTHER ENTITY' card is empty text occupying a primary slot.
fixes: Add 'Register entity', 'Issue shares', 'Add signer' buttons that the explanatory sentence promises.
Define 'Lazy' inline: 'Lazy = not yet on-chain; identified only by board hash'.
Hide or collapse the take-control card when there is nothing to take over.

top_issues: The 'PER COUNTERPARTY' card text overflows its right edge ('→ Manage → Dispute' is clipped), breaking the layout on a 1000px+ canvas.
Two long explanatory paragraphs ('Green is yours…', 'Violet is what a counterparty owes…') sit at the same weight as data, slowing the scan.
'Accounts co-signed 1 of 1' and 'Can dispute without asking 1 of 1' use fraction notation with no denominator meaning stated.
fixes: Constrain the per-counterparty card width and wrap the breadcrumb to a second line with an ellipsis + tooltip.
Move the color definitions into the legend chips themselves as hover text.
Spell out the fractions: '1 of your 1 account is co-signed'.

top_issues: The account-lane table uses '·' as a value separator and as a placeholder for zero, so '130.00 · 45.50' and '·' in SECURED are visually identical tokens with different meanings.
Column header 'LINES OUT · IN' is cryptic and the values (115.50 · 0.00) don't reveal which is out vs in.
The four top KPI cards plus table plus book plus recent is extremely dense; on smaller desktop widths it will not survive (responsive 660).
fixes: Use a real column grid with right-aligned numerics and a distinct dash for null; never reuse '·' for both.
Rename to 'Credit out / Credit in' with sub-labels.
Provide a collapsible 'compact' mode that hides the order book to protect narrow desktops.

top_issues: The scrim over the Desk is so dark that the still-relevant context (which view you're jumping from) is unreadable, making the palette feel like a separate app.
Each command row carries a right-aligned hint (e.g. 'send money', 'dense console') that competes with the command name for the same visual weight.
No keyboard affordance shown (↑/↓, Enter, Esc) despite it being a ⌘K palette.
fixes: Reduce scrim opacity to ~60% and blur lightly so the prior screen stays legible.
Mute hint text to a single lighter gray and right-align with fixed width.
Show a footer key legend: ↑↓ navigate · ⏎ open · esc close.

overall.verdict: This is a serious, trust-first wallet with a genuinely novel one-scale bar grammar and excellent proof/dispute surfaces that would win over security and DeFi power users. It is held back from a top tier by inconsistent number formatting, unexplained jargon on the first-timer path, a few over-stuffed screens (Swap, Assets, Desk) and one clipped layout on Sovereignty.
priority_fixes: Enforce a single money-format rule ($ prefix, ticker suffix, no bare numbers) across Home, Desk and Activity so every figure is instantly unit-readable.
Replace unexplained jargon (Secured, Hub promise, capacity, Lazy, basis points, LINES OUT·IN) with plain labels plus hover definitions on Home, Receive, Ownership, Lending and Desk.
Fix the Swap flow's blocking red warning and ambiguous decimal price so a power user can complete a swap in one screen without a side-quest.
Repair the Sovereignty per-counterparty text overflow and add the missing action buttons on Ownership so the two most trust-critical screens are complete.
Protect the first-timer path: surface Pay/Receive as the only visible verbs on Home and demote Desk/Manage/Sovereignty behind the command palette and Manage hub.
